lesson.title: The phone is dead
lesson.goal: The desk phone has no power. Find the switch port and turn power on.

step.text: The desk phone is plugged into OfficeSwitch port 2, but it is dark. A working phone needs power over its network cable.
Open OfficeSwitch and look at the port the phone is on. Power is being refused on that port.
On OfficeSwitch, go into that interface and allow power: power inline auto. The phone should come back.
Ping DeskPhone from DeskPC to prove the phone is alive again.
